```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"
model_version <- "fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2"
subset_name <- "all"

included_fragments <- fromJSON(paste0(
  to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/fragments_included_all.json")) %>%
  distinct() 

subset <- fromJSON(
  paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subsets_all.json")) %>%
  filter(image_name %in% included_fragments$image_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  select(image_name, pixel_length_um, pixel_area_um2)


mucosa_list  <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/mucosa_list_all.json")) %>%
  left_join(subset) %>%
  filter((orientation_class == "adequate" | orientation_class == "marginal") & (artefact_class == "adequate" | artefact_class == "marginal")) %>%
  distinct()

image_fragment_mucosa_names <- mucosa_list$name

which(image_fragment_mucosa_names == "17B1216_T1_he_2025-02-06_03_01")
```
